skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator and rewrite unlike-denominator fractions or fraction parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Align mixed and whole-number parts
skills.definition: Represent mixed numbers, whole numbers, or pure fractions in aligned whole-part and fraction-part form, subtract whole parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow from the whole part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units as d/d into the fractional part when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.

skills.name: Simplify final form
skills.definition: Normalize the final answer by reducing a fractional part to lowest terms or replacing a zero fractional part with an integer result.
